base.model: m1-draft-0.12/tools/sr_ref.py (the accepted World; loaded read-only, never edited)

fault.definition: When a data record (E, s) is issued, the key's sweep runs at once against (E, s): every record of the key below (E, s) is removed, the current maximum included, before the new record is applied. The correct sweep runs only after a record succeeds and removes records below the confirmed one.
fault.reading: validation.md:682 names the control and its failing cell (BR22a, P1, late apply of the remove); it does not spell out the mutation. This is the reading under which a remove can be pending at P1: in the correct model no gen-1 remove exists at P1, so no 'late remove' could be applied.

convention.text: A remove issued together with a set of a generation whose records do not settle by themselves (BR22a gen1, cfg settleRecords = false) is held like that set until the schedule places it. Otherwise it settles 1 ms after issue, as every other remove of the World.

pendingLabelAdded.RM: gen1 removes issued under the fault; placed at L1..L5 like A (category 'remove'); L0 = never applied. Only meaningful when first in {P1, P3, fail}.

handDerivation: t=10: T1 sends A = ['k1','x']; gen1 issues record (1,2). Under sweepMax it also issues remove (1,1) at once. Both are held (gen1 settleRecords = false; P-SM-1).
t=20: gen1 dies (P1). The new generation R = gen2 boots at rR = 70.
t=69 (L1 = rR - 1): the held remove of (1,1) is applied. No record of S_A remains, and none is greater: removedWithoutGreater and greatestRecordLost, so c7a fails.
gen2 reads no record, so its checkpoint and every snapshot lack k0; the final dictionary is {k1:'z', k2:'y'} without k0, so c1 fails.

baselineSameCell.expect: every criterion of run_checks_010.criteria passes, E rule holds, no violation; the correct model issues no gen-1 remove, so the RM placement finds nothing to apply

properties.text: With sweepMax off, the subclass reproduces run_checks_010.br22a_world exactly (items, snapshots, replies, violations, trace) on all 520 original combinations.
In the correct model no gen-1 remove is left unapplied at the end of any original combination: a remove never waits behind an unsettled greater record.

grid.labels: A, F2 or CP2 as in 0.10, plus RM
grid.assert: nothing beyond the control; the failing distribution is recorded
